THE LAND CONTROL (KARACHI DIVISION) ORDINANCE, 1948
THE LAND CONTROL (KARACHI DIVISION) ORDINANCE, 1948
ORDINANCE NO. XXVI OF 1948
(This Ordinance has been rep. in its
application to the Province of West Pakistan by West Pakistan Ordinance 12 of
1964 s. 2 (with effect from the 8th September, 1964).)
[29th November, 1948]
An Ordinance to make provision for controlling the transfer and the
market value of certain lands within the limits of the (Subs. by A. O., 1964, Art. 2 and Sch., for "Federal
Territory of Karachi" which had been subs. by the Repealing and Amending
Ordinance, 1961 (1 of 1961), for "Capital of the Federation".)[Karachi Division]
SCHEDULE
(See sections 2 and 5)
The area limited by the following
boundaries, namely:‑
North.‑From the junction of the metalled provincial road,
Karachi Thano Bula Khan and the road leading off this provincial road to Malir
Cantonment to where the pro vincial road meets the Malir to Mangho Pir Road,
thence along this road to Mangho Pir.
West.‑From Mangho Pir along the metalled road to Karachi up
to the District Local Board Toll Tax Station, thence along the eastern bank of
the Orangi Nai to Boundary Pillar No. 16 of the Trading Estate, thence along
the eastern boun dary of the Trading Estate and the eastern bank of the Oran 6
Nai to a point where it meet, the northern bank of the Lyari River thence along
the northern bank of the Lyari River to a point opposite the north‑eastern
corner of Pir Illahibux Colony No. 2, thence along the eastern boundary of the
said Colony to its south eastern corner and thence in a straight line to the
Karachi Thano Dula Khan provincial road, thence in a straight line along the
provincial road to the south‑eastern corner of the Islamabad Housing Co‑operative
Society, thence along the southern boundary of the said Society's land where it
meets the Cantonment boundary thence northwards along the Canton ment boundary
to boundary Pillar No. 13, thence along the Cantonment boundary via Pillars 12‑A
and 9‑B to the Military Slaughter House, thereafter in a straight line to
the north‑western corner of the land granted to the Sindhi Muslim Housing
Co- operative Society, thence along the northern and eastern boun daries of
this Society's lands to the North‑Western Railway line outside the
eastern corner of the Carriage Shops.
South.‑Along the North‑Western Railway line to a point
opposite the commencement of Jinnah Avenue, i.e., the road taking off from the
Karachi‑Malir Road and leading to Malir Cantonment.
East.‑The Jinnah Avenue Road to Cantonment Boundary Pillar
23, thence along the western boundary of Malir Canton ment and thence southern
and western boundaries of Military Camping Ground to the junction of the
Karachi‑Thano Bula Khan Road and the road leading to Malir Cantonment.

2. Interpretation. In this Ordinance "Schedule" means the
Schedule to this Ordinance; "specified area" means any area specified
in the Schedule; and "transfer" means a transfer within the meaning
of section 5 of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882, and its gram matical
variations shall be construed accordingly, IV of 1882.

Provincial Government to approve land transfers

An Ordinance to make provision for controlling the transfer and the

Territory of Karachi" which had been subs. by the Repealing and Amending
Ordinance, 1961 (1 of 1961), for "Capital of the Federation".)[Karachi Division]
3. Provincial Government to approve land transfers. No person shall
transfer any land lying within the specified area except with the prior
approval of the (Subs. by A. O., 1964, Art, 2 and Sch., for "Central
Government".)
[Provincial Government] in writing and any transfer made in contravention of
this section shall be void.

Market value in case of acquisitions

THE LAND CONTROL (KARACHI DIVISION) ORDINANCE, 1948
THE LAND CONTROL (KARACHI DIVISION) ORDINANCE, 1948
ORDINANCE NO. XXVI OF 1948
(This Ordinance has been rep. in its
application to the Province of West Pakistan by West Pakistan Ordinance 12 of
1964 s. 2 (with effect from the 8th September, 1964).)
[29th November, 1948]
An Ordinance to make provision for controlling the transfer and the
market value of certain lands within the limits of the (Subs. by A. O., 1964, Art. 2 and Sch., for "Federal
Territory of Karachi" which had been subs. by the Repealing and Amending
Ordinance, 1961 (1 of 1961), for "Capital of the Federation".)[Karachi Division]
4. Market value in case of acquisitions. Notwithstanding anything
to the contrary in any other enactment for the time being in force, the market
value of any land lying within the specified area shall, for the purposes of
determining the amount of compensation to be awarded therefore, if such laid is
acquired after the 31st March, 1948, in pursuance of a notification under sub‑section
(1) of section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, or by a notice under sub‑section
(3) of section 3 of the Sind (Requisition of Land) Act, 1947, be the lower
market value of the land determined with reference to its market value, I of
1894. Sind XLVI of 1947.
(a) on the 31st March, 1948, and
(b) on the date of the
notification or, as the case may be, of the notice aforesaid.

5. Power to amend schedule.
The (Subs.
by A. O., 1964, Art, 2 and Sch., for "Central Government".) [Provincial Government) may, by an
order (For
such an order, see Gaz., of P., 1959, Ext., p. 158.)published in the official Gazette, alter the boundaries of any
specified area, or omit any such area from the Schedule, or add any area to the
Schedule making it thereupon a specified area, and the Schedule thereupon be deemed
to be amended accordingly.
